newsitem.title: PANAMA: Latin American journalists put life on line - report.
newsitem.headline: Latin American journalists put life on line - report.

text.p: The murders of five journalists in Latin America in the past six months show that journalism remains a dangerous profession in the region, an international press group said on Tuesday.

The Inter-American Press Association (IAPA) said in a report at the end of a four-day annual meeting in Panama City that since October, three journalists have been killed in Colombia, one in Guatemala and one in Argentina.
More than 170 journalists have been murdered in the hemisphere in the past decade.
"These deaths make it clear that many countries are incapable of guaranteeing freedom of expression and of the press," the IAPA report said.
The study of 24 nations, including the United States and Canada, highlighted a variety of restrictions and government laws which threatened press freedom.
